metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working in a repository: the galdr hooks and the lead workflow, with the skills they use.

plugins.name: galdr
plugins.description: Session hooks and a status line: web search routing, temporary-file pruning, session preflight and worktree guards.

plugins.name: lead
plugins.description: The lead workflow: a model ladder, task categories and the four category agents.

plugins.name: prose
plugins.description: Prose in German and English without em dashes or machine rhythm, with a checker.

plugins.name: conventional-commits
plugins.description: Commit messages in Conventional Commits 1.0.0, shaped by the repository's own history.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session handoffs: the goal as a parent work item, the next steps as sub-items, the state as one comment.

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Session notes: the noteworthy work of a session, under fixed sections.

plugins.name: ai-memory
plugins.description: Memory notes: one fact per note, with a flat format that retrieval can inject.

plugins.name: simplify-changes
plugins.description: A behavior-preserving simplification pass that never deletes error handling.

plugins.name: conscience
plugins.description: A sparring conscience for abstractions, dependencies and data-layout decisions.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian skills from the upstream obsidian-skills marketplace, pinned by commit.
